scope: Research-only common-portfolio test of frozen BCF and current-v5 MC1 mappings. BCF is used as a conservative agreement signal: common candidates must clear the same mapped-EV threshold in both families. The frozen grid changes only priority between BCF MC1 EV and predeclared BCF/current-v5 EV blends. No live configuration changed.

fixed_contract.score_inputs: Frozen score-family final_score inputs; BCF's input remains the stored CDF42(raw_severe) final-score contract. Neither final-score field is recalculated.
fixed_contract.mc1: Previously rerun frozen MC1_d2 mapper on repaired canonical labels; no mapper refit or retuning in this ablation.
fixed_contract.agreement_gate: BCF MC1 EV >= threshold AND current-v5 MC1 EV >= threshold; thresholds 30, 40, 50, 60 bps.
fixed_contract.priority: BCF-only MC1 EV control and blends with BCF weights 10%, 25%, 33.333%, 50%.
fixed_contract.portfolio: one common global-auction state per arm; long-only; canonical policy outcome; 7x; 10% margin slots; two entries/hour; eight concurrent; 80% wallet cap; invalid outcomes excluded before capacity allocation.

selection.reason: It raises total net bps, EV/trade, accepted trades/day, worst month, worst week, and max-drawdown-adjusted total versus the current-v5 mapped-EV-priority control while reducing days below one/five trades.
selection.frozen_2025_test: Only both_t30_bcf_priority was tested against the same current-v5 control; no 2025 retuning occurred.
selection.2025_result: Total net bps and net-to-drawdown both increase; EV/trade declines 4.0%, a transparent participation trade-off.

commands: 2026 full 20-arm grid then frozen winner-only 2025 replay
properties: Exact canonical policy fields are already identity-audited in the parent v9 comparison across 522070 overlapping candidate IDs.
All selected trades in both replays have realised canonical policy outcomes; coverage is 100%.
No live artifact, exchange action, or production threshold was changed.
